title: Copilot — Traces (Tempo)
description: GitHub Copilot distributed traces from Tempo. Search, filter, and drill into individual Copilot interactions at the span level — see every LLM call, tool execution, agent turn, and hook with precise timing and gen_ai.* attributes.

panels.title: ℹ️ How to use this dashboard

options.content:
## Copilot Traces — Tempo

**Source:** Distributed traces from GitHub Copilot Chat, captured as OTel spans and stored in Tempo. Each Copilot interaction produces a root `invoke_agent` or `chat` span with nested child spans for every tool call, LLM call, and hook.

### Span tree structure (what you'll see per interaction)
```
invoke_agent [root] — entire agent orchestration
├── chat — one LLM call (model request + response)
├── execute_tool readFile — tool call with timing
├── execute_tool runCommand
├── execute_hook PreToolUse — hook pass/block
└── chat — follow-up LLM call after tool results
```

### Key span attributes (dotted, native OTel)
- `gen_ai.request.model` — model requested
- `gen_ai.response.model` — model that actually responded (may differ)
- `gen_ai.operation.name` — chat / execute_tool / invoke_agent
- `gen_ai.token.type` — input / output
- `service.name` — copilot-chat or github-copilot (CLI)
- `gen_ai.agent.name` — agent identifier
- `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` — stop, max_tokens, content_filter, etc.

### Filters
- **Service** — scope to copilot-chat (extension) or github-copilot (CLI)
- **Model** — filter by model (uses VictoriaMetrics for label population)
- **Operation** — focus on specific span types
- **Min Duration** — find slow interactions

### Workflow
1. Use **Red Signals** section to spot error/slow traces
2. Use **Trace Search** table to find specific interactions
3. Click a trace row to open the **Trace Detail** panel and see every span
4. Use **Node Graph** to visualise the service topology (if enabled in Tempo)

### ⚠️ Tempo TraceQL attribute names use dots (not underscores)
Example: `{ span.gen_ai.operation.name = "chat" }` NOT `{ span.gen_ai_operation_name = "chat" }`

panels.title: Error Traces
panels.description: Count of traces with at least one error span in the selected window. Source: TraceQL status=error filter.

panels.title: Slow Traces (>10s)
panels.description: Count of traces with root span duration over 10 seconds. These are the interactions most likely to frustrate developers.

panels.title: Total Traces
panels.description: Total count of root traces (invoke_agent or chat) from Copilot in the selected window.

panels.title: Unique Models Seen
panels.description: Count of distinct model names observed in trace span attributes during the selected window. Useful to confirm model variety is being captured.

panels.title: Error Traces — Investigate These First
panels.description: Traces where at least one span has status=error. Click a trace row to load it in the Trace Detail panel below. Look at finish_reasons and error attributes on the failing span.

panels.title: All Recent Traces
panels.description: Searchable table of recent Copilot traces. Filter by Model, Service, Operation, or Min Duration using the dashboard variables above. Click any row to open that trace in the Trace Detail panel below. Each row is one complete Copilot interaction.

panels.title: Slowest Tool-Call Spans
panels.description: Individual execute_tool spans sorted by duration. Identifies which specific tools are creating latency within agent interactions. Source: TraceQL span search on execute_tool spans.

panels.title: Slowest Chat Spans by Model
panels.description: Individual chat spans (LLM calls) sorted by duration. Shows which model invocations are taking longest. Drill into a row's parent trace to see the full interaction context.

panels.title: Custom TraceQL Query
panels.description:
Use this panel to run any TraceQL query directly. Example queries:
- All chat spans: `{ span.gen_ai.operation.name = "chat" }`
- Slow agents: `{ rootName = "invoke_agent" && duration > 30s }`
- Specific model: `{ span.gen_ai.request.model = "claude-opus-4-6" }`
- Errors only: `{ status = error }`
- MCP tool calls: `{ span.gen_ai.tool.type = "extension" }`

Edit the target expression directly in panel edit mode.

panels.title: Trace Detail — Full Span Breakdown
panels.description: Full span-level breakdown of a selected trace. Shows every child span (chat, execute_tool, invoke_agent, execute_hook), their gen_ai.* attributes, and exact timing. Equivalent to the App Insights 'End-to-end transaction' view. Select a trace from any table above to load it here. Look for: long chat spans (slow model), many execute_tool spans (complex agentic task), execute_hook spans that show pass/block decisions.

panels.title: Latency Metrics (from Tempo via VictoriaMetrics exemplars)
Operation Duration P50 / P90 / P99 Over Time
panels.description: Latency percentiles over time pulled from VictoriaMetrics (not Tempo), displayed here for correlation with trace activity above. Click any data point — if exemplar linking is configured in Grafana datasource settings, you can jump directly to the trace that represents that latency value.
